column1: # Quantum defects at the series limit, Hartree-Slater calculation against
# experiment. Theodosiou, Manson & Inokuti, "Spectral and electron-collision
# properties of atomic ions: Threshold phase shifts", Phys. Rev. A 34, 943
# (1986), Tables I-V. PDF supplied by M 2026-08-11.
# THIS IS THE PRA COMPANION, NOT THE ADNDT TABLES. Its own reference 32 is
# "C.E. Theodosiou, M. Inokuti, S.T. Manson, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables (to be
# published)" — that is ADNDT 35, 473, which D3 still wants. This paper covers
# Z <= 37; R 1217 records the ADNDT paper as covering Z <= 50.
# Seaton's theorem, the paper's eq (1):  pi * mu_l(n -> inf) = delta_l(E = 0)
# so the asymptotic quantum defect IS the zero-energy scattering phase shift
# in units of pi. Confirms R 1547's reading.
